hints.title: First Occurrence Tracking
hints.text: Record the first index where each character appears in the string.

hints.title: Calculate Distance
hints.text: When seeing a character again at index i, the distance between them is i minus first index minus one.

hints.title: Maintain Running Maximum
hints.text: Track the maximum distance found across all repeated characters, returning negative one if none repeat.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every pair of characters takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A fixed 26-element array records first seen positions in O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should return -1 if no character appears more than once.
